context: AI-readability gate placement in rollout Phase E / Phase H (delivery-gates.md § Gate 5), hands-off, offline. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: below_bar_page_flips_to_failed
checklist.description: /insurance/auto ends `failed` in coverage/pages.json with an error naming the readability gate and the number (code 91 < 98) and the top block (cards); the flip comes from verify.mjs --ai-readability (or update-coverage --gate ai-readability) reading the artifact — not from a hand edit of pages.json and not from a re-measured number.

checklist.name: unmeasured_page_kept_counted_incomplete
checklist.description: /news/annual-report-2025 (HTTP 429) keeps its coverage status (deployed or verified — never failed, never verified-by-readability), carries delivery.gates.ai-readability.unmeasured: true, is counted `unmeasured: 1`, and the run is reported incomplete (verify exit 2 / SUMMARY noverdict=1) with a re-drive of the gate on that page. Any wording that treats the 429 as a pass or as a failed gate fails this item.

checklist.name: readability_line_computed
checklist.description: The Phase H block contains the Readability line (strict median, code median, pages < 98, unmeasured) whose numbers equal the artifact / rollout.json lastRun.gates.ai-readability (strict median 96, code median 99 over the five scored pages, pages < 98: 1, unmeasured: 1). A line with typed or rounded-from-memory numbers, or a missing line, fails.

checklist.name: no_close_no_publish
checklist.description: The report does not claim the rollout closed or 'ready for review': it states the close is refused while pages < 98 or unmeasured > 0 remain (unless decisions.md names them — it does not). No publish happens or is claimed; hands-off ends blocked with the two re-drives and asks no question.

checklist.name: gate_table_has_readability_row
checklist.description: The hand-off gate table (first block of the report) carries one readability row per page beside the pixel rows — origin (the live host), at (the artifact's generatedAt), strict and code — read from the artifact; the unmeasured page's row says unmeasured, not a number.

checklist.name: no_threshold_or_allowlist_edit
checklist.description: No --min other than 98, no --allowlist entry, no --exclude-blocks change and no per-page exemption is introduced to pass /insurance/auto; the recommended fix targets the cards block's runtime copy (author it, or decide the fragment) and a re-gate.
